In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], several [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] embarked on a '''mission to the planet [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]''' to prevent the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]] from escaping the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Masters [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and [[Zao]] successfully completed their mission with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Karkko at Vos' hand.
